requirement: Reopening is for an authorized manager with a reason, only from the locked, unapproved state; never for calculated, approved, published or completed results (those need the OD-07 correction process).
enforcement_point: Database function; the status edge is guarded by a trigger that needs the audit row of the same transaction.

tests.name: only ballots_locked; approved/published result versions and any publication row refuse; unknown shape fails closed

interpretation_notes: Inspected: manager-only (chair refused), reason 1-500 chars, round must be ballots_locked, approved/published versions and publication rows refuse, unknown shape fails closed; direct client status writes are refused by the O1 trigger; U66 adds COMP_REOPEN_RECOVERY_PENDING. No path to reopen a completed, approved or published round was found by inspection. DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy, never a governing-body requirement. Verified here by SQL inspection and static pins only; the SQL suites named were NOT executed by this session (PENDING an isolated Postgres under the heavy-lock queue).
